self_metadata: Scan report and manifest bytes also scanned before writing.
qualification: Finite scan of named plaintext and generated metadata against privately derived local path and key values, nontrivial prefixes and raw and hexadecimal SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5 digests, plus selected path and credential patterns. Values and digests are not emitted; ciphertexts, unknown encodings and unspecified inputs are outside scope.
